actions.action: Dab a suspected insect with a damp or alcohol swab to confirm mealybug vs scale
Isolate the plant from other plants
Dab each visible insect with 70% isopropyl alcohol on a cotton swab, checking leaf undersides, stem joints and soil surface
Spray the whole plant and soil surface with insecticidal soap or neem oil every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
If the plant is slow or wilting, inspect the roots; if mealybugs are present, wash the roots and repot in fresh soil
Check nearby plants for mealybugs after about a month without new insects

reason: The answer names mealybugs as the main diagnosis and leads with dabbing them with alcohol and inspecting thoroughly, matching the fix that worked; its extra steps are standard and safe.
